notes: All sessions used owned private Xvfb displays; existing user sessions were not targeted.
The first compound attempt ended at its 300-second deadline. A later 1800-second run completed all twenty cases; no observation timeout was treated as process completion.

Manual startup-recovery input was queued into the first face batch and appears after its first Flip in the retained history. A fresh full sixteen-case batch without manual intervention supplies clean evidence.
Every retained response was compared recursively with its original, including every numeric IEEE-754 bit pattern, after JSON compaction.
Independent Fraction box integrals use only source sizes and senses. Observed scalar results do not define native input or desired orientation.
This audit disproves global volume-sign normalization but does not implement or claim a general spatial orientation classifier.
These are public-API and actual-command behavioral witnesses, not an identical-source native replay or a kernel-speed benchmark.
